description: Defines the 'slot_point' class and related constants and functions for handling radio slot timing in 3GPP-like systems, including slot calculations, comparisons, and conversions.

classes.name: slot_point
classes.description: Represents a specific slot in the radio frame, including methods for comparison, arithmetic, and conversion based on numerology, SFN, and slot index.

methods.name: set_slot_numerology
methods.description: Converts a slot_point to a different numerology, applying floor operation when converting to a lower numerology.
